Package dk.sdu.imada.teaching.compiler.fs25.vvpl.scan

Class Scanner

java.lang.Object
dk.sdu.imada.teaching.compiler.fs25.vvpl.scan.Scanner
public class Scanner extends Object
The Scanner class performs lexical analysis of a VVPL source program. It transforms the raw character stream into a sequence of Token objects according to the lexical rules of the VVPL language.
Version:
CompilerConstruction FT 2025
Author:
Lucas Bergholdt Hansen

    • string

      private void string()
      Scans the character sequence of a string literal consuming until the closing " is found. Unterminated strings at EOF or strings spanning too many lines result in a scan error.

    • number

      private void number()
      Scans a seires of digits potentially followed by a decimpal point. Leading and trailing decimal points are not allowed.

    • identifier

      private void identifier()
      Scans an identifier or keyword. If a reserved keyword is matched, the corresponding keyword token is produced. Otherwise, an IDENTIFIER token is produced.
